assessment.data_source: Fictional mock inventory created for learning and documentation
assessment.disclaimer: All assets, IP addresses, hostnames, configurations, findings, and events are fictional and must not be used against real networks.

scope.assessment_boundary: The simulated Northwind Business Solutions enterprise network, including its perimeter, internal LAN, server VLAN, wireless networks, management VLAN, and centralized security monitoring system.
assessment_objectives: Evaluate network segmentation and traffic-control boundaries
Evaluate protection of critical servers and backup systems
Identify defensive improvements and prioritize remediation
in_scope: Firewall, router, core switch, servers, wireless access points, and SIEM
out_of_scope: Active exploitation or testing against real systems
